root_cause.text: The F2FS Fast Garbage Collection (FGGC) node block migration path failed to clear the dentry and fsync marks on node folios before writing, unlike the Background Garbage Collection (BGGC) path, causing fsck to misinterpret stale metadata flags as valid fsync data.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves `set_dentry_mark(folio, false)` and `set_fsync_mark(folio, do_fsync)` into `__write_node_folio`, consolidating the mark clearing logic that was previously only explicitly performed in `f2fs_sync_node_pages` (used by BGGC) but missing in the FGGC migration flow.
